subject.title: feat(chat): migrate chat surface to Reactor

question: Should the application adopt a preview Reactor dependency as the default native chat renderer now, or should the migration remain staged until the team accepts the accessibility and scrolling rollout boundary?
rationale: The patch changes the product's default native chat implementation rather than repairing an established failure. Tests and a successful launch do not resolve the intended rollout policy for a new preview rendering framework.

options.title: Stage the Reactor rollout
options.body: Keep the existing native chat as the default until focused accessibility diagnostics and real scrolling proof support a controlled migration.

options.title: Adopt Reactor now
options.body: Accept the framework migration as the default path after the diagnostic scope is fixed and current-head behavior proof demonstrates the supported chat scenarios.

recommendation.title: Stage the Reactor rollout
recommendation.body: Keep the existing native chat as the default until focused accessibility diagnostics and real scrolling proof support a controlled migration.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the migration and the linked follow-up, making them the closest available technical contact while the actual product decision remains with repository leadership.
